title: Customer risk profiling for security asks and fast-path SLA lanes
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Design and ship a deterministic customer risk-profiling scorer that powers an intake fast-path for low-risk security & compliance asks (SOC2/ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, vendor questionnaires). The scorer will combine account context (hosting mode, contract stage, industry), data sensitivity signals, prior questionnaire history, and requested SLA to produce a risk band (low/medium/high). Low-risk requests should be eligible for an automated Fast Path with a predictable SLA and an auto-assembled evidence bundle. The goal is to reduce mean time to first response for low-risk enterprise asks, focus security/legal effort on medium/high cases, and provide traceable decisions for audits.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic scoring function documented and versioned in Confluence with input features and weights
Pilot dataset of 200 historical intake items annotated; automated scorer aligns with existing human triage >= 85% on low/medium/high bands
Intake UI surfaces a clear risk band, recommended SLA lane, and a one-click ‘Fast Path’ action for eligible low-risk asks
Automated evidence bundle generator produces initial artifact set for Fast Path (SOC2 report link, last pen test statement, A/V snapshot) for >= 70% of low-risk cases
Metrics dashboard in Console shows daily Fast Path eligibility rate, mean time to first response, and accuracy drift alerts
Operational runbook for exceptions, manual escalation, and rollback published; security_review_required set and completed before rollout
implementation_plan: Discovery (1 week): map existing intake fields, list all available account signals from CRM and Console, and catalog typical evidence artifacts
Data prep (2 weeks): extract 200 historical intake tickets, normalize labels, and create gold labels with security/legal SMEs

Scoring design (1 week): define feature set (hosting_mode, data_residency_required, contract_stage, questionnaire_size, prior_evidence_count, customer_tier) and a simple weighted rule engine for initial rollout
Prototype UI (2 weeks): update intake form mock in Figma; add risk band, recommended SLA, and Fast Path CTA; review with design and support
Automation (3 weeks): implement server-side scorer, evidence-bundler microservice, and intake workflow integration; add audit trail headers and version ID
Pilot (2 weeks): run on opt-in accounts, log decisions, gather SME feedback, and measure alignment/MTTR improvements
Rollout (1 week): enable Fast Path for all eligible accounts; update support runbooks and page on internal docs
Post-rollout (ongoing): weekly monitoring for drift, monthly policy reviews, and quarterly model/weight tuning
open_questions: What exact SLA windows should constitute 'Fast Path' (24h, 48h?) and should they vary by customer tier?
Which evidence artifacts are sufficient as a default bundle for each major regulation (SOC2 vs HIPAA vs GDPR)?
How do we represent partial evidence (e.g., SOC2 in progress) in the scorer without blocking Fast Path eligibility?
Do we allow product/solutions teams to opt accounts out of Fast Path via a flag?
What telemetry thresholds should trigger a manual review or rollback of the scorer?
